name: incremental_watermark
description: Parcel scans loaded by a scanner feed, and an incremental fact table over them. Scanners report in batches, so many scans share a timestamp, and a scanner with no clock sends none. The fact table's watermark is strict and it appends, so a scan arriving after the nightly run with the latest timestamp already loaded is never picked up, and a naive inclusive watermark loads rows twice. Only an incremental run shows either; a full refresh hides both.
